source: WorldPop (2025). Constrained estimates of 2015-2030 total number of people per grid square, 3 arc-seconds (about 100 m), R2025A v1. University of Southampton. DOI:10.5258/SOTON/WP00839. CC BY 4.0
method: Each 100 m square's people, times the share of that square under the water the radar saw (measured on a 10 x 10 sub-grid), summed by upazila. A square is counted in the upazila holding its centre.
limitations: A modelled estimate, not a headcount: WorldPop spreads census totals over squares with buildings. Radar misses water between houses and under trees, where people live, so the real number is probably higher.
